  https://github.com/NLnetLabs/nsd/blob/NSD_4_14_2_REL/doc/ChangeLog
- update to 4.14.1:

  https://github.com/NLnetLabs/nsd/blob/NSD_4_12_0_REL/doc/ChangeLog

- enable dnstap support.
- enable tcp fast open support
